# Two Poems in Poetry Salzburg Review 32

![](https://www.robertpeake.com/files/2018/07/psr32.jpg)

[Poetry Salzburg](http://www.poetrysalzburg.com/) has been good to me and my work, including publishing [The Silence Teacher](https://www.robertpeake.com/the-silence-teacher) in 2013. The two poems that appear in [the latest issue](http://www.poetrysalzburg.com/psr-no32.htm) represent the fifth time they have accepted work (including poems and reviews) for publication. I am truly grateful.

Grateful, also, for two excellent new poems by Abegail Morley, and an astute survey of her recent work by William Bedford. As always, beneath an enticingly surreal cover rests a trove of delights. You can order [issue 32](http://www.poetrysalzburg.com/psr-no32.htm) from the website.

Here is a [quick snap of the two poems in situ](https://www.robertpeake.com/files/2018/07/IMG_2533.jpg). The first one will also appear in [Cyclone](https://www.robertpeake.com/cyclone), which comes out next week.
